texts.preamble: Brahma Trading Company Through Its ... vs The State Of Bihar Through The ... on 10 February, 2021 Author: Rajeev Ranjan Prasad Bench: Rajeev Ranjan Prasad In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna (From Official Chambers Via Video Conferencing) Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No.408 of 2020 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-224 Year-2020 Thana- Manjhagarh District- ====================================================== Brahma Trading Company Through Its Proprietor Brahma Nanda Puri and Anr. ... ... Pe Versus The State of Bihar Through the Additional Chief Sect. Dept. of Home(Pol Govt. Of Bihar, Patna and Ors. ... ... Respo ====================================================== Appearance : For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Prabhat Ranjan,Advocate For the Respondent/s : Mr.Suman Kumar Jha,AC to Aag-3 ====================================================== Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajeev Ranjan Prasad Oral Order
texts.arguments: Learned counsel submits that since the copy of the writ application has been served upon him only day before yesterday, he has yet to seek instruction in the matter and file an appropriate affidavit. Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn the attention of this Court towards the judgment and order dated 19.07.2016 passed by Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in CWJC No. 3805 of 2015 and other analogues matter wherein the Hon'ble Division Bench has been pleased to observe as under:- "135. COTPA, being a parent legislation, is the Patna High Court CR. Learned counsel further submits that in a similar matter a learned Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has vide judgment dated 01.06.2016 passed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 551 of 2016 held that the very seizure and institution of the First Information Report and all the subsequent acts were wholly without jurisdiction and those were [LEAKAGE_MASK] with a direction to release the truck of the petitioner with all the goods. Learned counsel submits that in the present case also the petitioner is ready to submit sufficient security and as such this Court may consider release of the goods.

COTPA, being a parent legislation, is the Patna High Court CR. Learned counsel further submits that in a similar matter a learned Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has vide judgment dated 01.06.2016 passed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 551 of 2016 held that the very seizure and institution of the First Information Report and all the subsequent acts were wholly without jurisdiction and those were [LEAKAGE_MASK] with a direction to release the truck of the petitioner with all the goods.
